description.value: Kitcho Izakaya is a Japanese izakaya-style restaurant in Richmond, BC, a city renowned for its depth of Asian dining. Izakayas are casual Japanese gastropubs centred on shared small plates and drinks, making them a sociable stop for cyclists after a day on the road. Richmond's flat terrain and extensive cycling infrastructure make this area a natural destination for touring cyclists exploring the Lower Mainland.
